answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 59759 Country: India Title: Types of special namaz like tasbeeh etc Kaffara for missed namaz Question: What is the kaffarah for a woman/man who has never prayed namaz or missed namaz and now want to find a way to sort out. Also, what are the other special prayers which is once prayed in a lifetime. Answer ID: 59759 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 428/428/SD=08/1436) (1) In case, the said man and woman are alive then it is mandatory for them to make qaza of all the salah which they have missed. There is no way except offering them. عن أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه عن النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: من نسي صلاةً، فليصل إذا ذكر لا كفارة لها إلا ذلك . (البخارى، كتاب موقيت الصلاة، رقم: 597) قال العثماني التهانوي: دلالته على وجوب القضاء ظاهرة، حيث دل لفظ الأمر. (إعلاء السنن: 7/141، بيروت). (2) We only provide guidance pertaining Shariah ruling, we do not solve puzzles. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
